mapping_method: Preserve all154 previous mappings except explicit genuine Q18 survival additions; append all9 surviving real-core questions before any expanded answers. Separate unasked key background. Reachability credit remains separate from grading requirements.
grading_scope: Judge all actually requested material facts using equivalent wording and implied actors in context. A fixed key may include explanatory background; key_context_not_required is not an additional answer requirement or tested source coverage. A response need not recite stipulated givens or a counting guard if its answer already respects them.

creator_provenance.role: Pre-test consolidation of both independently accepted map16 context corrections

questions.question: If Powerstorm grants a Spirit a Repeat of a Power Card that it already paid to play, must that Spirit pay the card’s Energy cost again to use that Repeat?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Repeat payment after the original play cost
required_facts: Yes; to use that Powerstorm Repeat, pay the repeated Power Card's Energy cost again, in addition to the original play payment.

key_context_not_required.fact: The same condition applies to further Repeat permissions from the threshold.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The generic payment condition covers those too; the prompt does not request a separate threshold recital or count.

questions.question: Dahan Enheartened at Terror II or III gives each player Gather and Damage instructions in their chosen land. Players A and B each choose to Gather one Dahan. May A Gather, then B Gather, then both deal their Damage, or must one player finish that player's full instructions before the next begins?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: May the two players interleave Gather and Damage?
required_facts: One player must finish the full Gather-and-Damage instruction sequence before the next starts; the proposed interleaving is not allowed.

key_context_not_required.fact: Players choose which player goes first.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks interleaving, not player-order selection.

questions.question: After a primary action and all triggered actions finish, an Invader is still illegally placed. Do players check victory/defeat with that illegal position first, or correct its position before that check? Assume a legal destination exists.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Cleanup or outcome check first?
required_facts: Correct the illegal position after the completed action tree but before checking victory/defeat; check the cleaned-up state.

key_context_not_required.fact: The normal cleanup uses the nearest legal land and is not an action.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Those are directly asked in Q81, not separately requested by this ordering question; a legal destination is stipulated.

questions.question: Thunderspeaker has met both a threshold making one of its Innates Fast and a threshold that can affect game state. Is the Speed-changing threshold handled only as an ordinary effect when resolving that Innate, or applied before checking the phase in which the Innate can be used?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When the Fast threshold is applied
required_facts: Apply the Speed-changing threshold when checking the Innate's Speed/phase, before its ordinary effects rather than waiting until ordinary effect resolution.

key_context_not_required.fact: The met Fast threshold allows Fast use in this case.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: This follows directly from applying the stipulated threshold at the phase check; do not require another recital of the given threshold or Elements.

key_context_not_required.fact: Later Elements cannot retroactively legalize earlier targets or phases.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The refined question omits this already-tested Q27 subject.

questions.question: Bringer has used Vengeance of the Dead in a land. A later action by another Spirit actually destroys a Town there, causing Bringer's Vengeance to trigger. Is the triggered Damage real because the other Spirit caused the trigger, or does it still follow To Dream a Thousand Deaths?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Source and real-versus-nightmare Damage
required_facts: The delayed trigger remains Bringer's Power, follows To Dream a Thousand Deaths and deals hypothetical rather than real Damage; the other Spirit causing the trigger does not take ownership.

key_context_not_required.fact: Qualifying hypothetical destruction produces the usual nightmare Fear/Push.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks whether the triggered effect remains Bringer's Power; it does not request Fear values or a separate piece-type list.

questions.question: A populated land matches both the Ravage card and the Build card this turn. A Spread of Rampant Green has three Presence in that land and uses Choke the Land with Green to skip its Ravage, destroying one of those Presence. No other effect changes the land before Build. Does that payment also skip the later Build, or must Green choose again and destroy another of its Presence there? Is the remaining Sacred Site sufficient for that second use?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does the Ravage payment cover the later Build?
required_facts: No; the first payment skips only the Ravage, not the later Build.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Decision and cost for the later Build
required_facts: Skipping the later Build requires a fresh optional choice and another of Green's Presence destroyed in that land.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Is the remaining Sacred Site sufficient?
required_facts: Yes; the Presence remaining before Build still forms the required Sacred Site for the second use.

key_context_not_required.fact: Two disks remain before the Build choice and one after a second payment.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks whether the site suffices and whether a new payment is required; an equivalent correct response need not independently recite every intermediate/final count.

key_context_not_required.fact: The original two-Build proposal lacked a verified base producer.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Scope provenance, not an answer requirement. The frozen question instead uses normal Ravage then Build.

questions.question: A Ravage destroys a Dahan. Thunderspeaker has no Presence in the ravaged land but has its own Presence in an adjacent land. Can Sworn to Victory require destruction of that nearby Presence, or is the rule confined to Presence in the ravaged land?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: May adjacent own Presence be lost?
required_facts: Yes; Sworn to Victory can require Thunderspeaker's adjacent Presence, rather than being confined to the ravaged land.

key_context_not_required.fact: The general footprint is Range 1 and the loss is per Dahan after the whole Ravage.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt tests the given adjacent-Presence case; general timing and multiplier are not separate requests here. Q76 directly asks the timing/case loss.

questions.question: The Trees and Stones Speak of War has created its per-Dahan Defend in a land also benefiting from Words of Warning's separate Defend 3. Trees and Stones meets its threshold and Pushes one Dahan out. Does that Dahan carry the separate Defend 3 too, or only its own Defend 2 from Trees and Stones?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Which Defend travels?
required_facts: Only the fixed Trees and Stones Defend 2 travels with that Dahan; Words of Warning's separate Defend 3 does not travel.

key_context_not_required.fact: The separate Defend remains in the original land alongside the retained Trees Defend.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks what travels, rather than requiring another independent description of all effects remaining behind.

key_context_not_required.fact: Words of Warning's attack-timing effect also does not become a traveling effect.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks Defend, not attack timing.

questions.question: A copy of the core game contains 14 Presence disks of one color. Should all 14 be used for that Spirit's setup and later Presence availability, or is one a spare?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Use all 14 or treat one as spare?
required_facts: Use 13 Presence of that color; the extra disk is a spare and is not available for setup or later gameplay.

questions.question: In standard one-Spirit solo, are any of the eight original-core Spirits prohibited because their special restrictions appear to require teammates, including Ocean's Hungry Grasp or Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Any original Spirits prohibited in one-Spirit solo?
required_facts: None are prohibited: all eight original-core Spirits are permitted in solo, including the named Ocean and Bringer.

key_context_not_required.fact: The FAQ also says solo wins are possible with each Spirit, without guaranteeing every play state.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks selection legality, not strategy, winnability proofs or a guarantee.

key_context_not_required.fact: Use ordinary solo targeting and each Spirit's normal restrictions.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Those are already separately tested; no extra recital is requested here.

questions.question: A Spirit with no Energy remaining receives Gift of Strength and has already used an eligible cost-1 Power Card. May it use that card's Repeat without paying its cost again, or does Gift require the same repayment as Powerstorm?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: The eligible Gift of Strength Repeat requires no additional Energy payment and may be used with zero Energy remaining.
required_facts: The eligible Gift of Strength Repeat requires no additional Energy payment and may be used with zero Energy remaining.

key_context_not_required.fact: Powerstorm separately requires repayment.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Comparison context already directly asked by Q154; no separate restatement or new novelty credit.

questions.question: When Green adds Presence via Growth, may it use destroyed disks while tracks still contain Presence? What is the price while Healthy versus Blighted? Does this special rule also let an ordinary Power Add Presence use destroyed disks?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Destroyed Presence may optionally supply Green’s Growth placements before tracks are empty.
required_facts: Destroyed Presence may optionally supply Green’s Growth placements before tracks are empty.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: This use is free while Healthy and costs 1 Energy per destroyed Presence added while Blighted.
required_facts: This use is free while Healthy and costs 1 Energy per destroyed Presence added while Blighted.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Steady Regeneration applies to Growth, so an ordinary Power placement needs its own destroyed-Presence permission.
required_facts: Steady Regeneration applies to Growth, so an ordinary Power placement needs its own destroyed-Presence permission.

key_context_not_required.fact: Healthy/Blighted means the Blight Card state; Green has ordinary Power placement via Overgrow in a Night.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Health-state selector is separately asked by Q74; named Power is producer proof, not a recall requirement here.

questions.question: Ocean has previously Drowned Invaders stored on its panel. Between actions in a later Spirit Phase, may it exchange them for Energy to help pay for cards that turn, or must it wait for another Drowning or the Gain Energy step?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Ocean may exchange stored Drowned Invaders at the stated between-actions time in the later Spirit Phase; it need not wait for another Drowning or the normal Gain Energy step.
required_facts: Ocean may exchange stored Drowned Invaders at the stated between-actions time in the later Spirit Phase; it need not wait for another Drowning or the normal Gain Energy step.

key_context_not_required.fact: The normal X unmodified Health per Energy conversion still applies.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks when stored pieces may be exchanged, not a new Health/Spirits calculation or universal guarantee of a particular Energy amount.

questions.question: Ocean chooses its Growth option with two “Add a Presence in any Ocean” instructions. May one disk be placed in the Ocean of a different island board where Ocean currently has no Presence, without measuring a numeric Range from its existing Presence?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: The explicit any-Ocean Growth instruction may place in another board’s Ocean without preexisting Presence there or a numeric Range origin.
required_facts: The explicit any-Ocean Growth instruction may place in another board’s Ocean without preexisting Presence there or a numeric Range origin.

key_context_not_required.fact: Ordinary Range-1 Coastal-land Growth cannot treat Ocean as Coastal Wetland.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: This clause was explicitly removed as already asked by Q78; do not add it back as a requirement or new credit.

questions.question: When Spirits May Yet Dream grants its target an Element, may that Spirit choose an Element it currently has none of, or must the chosen Element already be present?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: The granted Element must be a type the target already has at least one of; an absent Element cannot be chosen.
required_facts: The granted Element must be a type the target already has at least one of; an absent Element cannot be chosen.

key_context_not_required.fact: The Element grant is at the printed3-Moon level. Bringer Card Plays track is2,2,2,3,3,Any.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Threshold/track numerical payloads are not asked or novelty. Raw adjudication mislabeled that Card Plays track as Energy; exact primary-based annotation correction is preserved separately.

questions.question: Green chooses its Reclaim-and-gain-Power Growth group. Does it also perform the separate ALWAYS Add Presence to Jungle/Wetland, or must it choose between that addition and Reclaim?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Green performs the separate ALWAYS placement in addition to the selected Reclaim-and-gain-Power Growth group.
required_facts: Green performs the separate ALWAYS placement in addition to the selected Reclaim-and-gain-Power Growth group.

key_context_not_required.fact: Green chooses only one optional group.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The all-other-optional-groups clause was removed as already asked by Q124; the remaining question asks the Always-plus-selected-group structure only.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does this same Town produce nightmare-destruction Fear a second time during one Tsunami use?
required_facts: The same Town provides nightmare-destruction Fear only once during that single Tsunami use; moving it between affected lands does not reset the per-Power, per-Invader limit.

key_context_not_required.fact: The Town contributes2nightmare Fear in total, rather than4.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Q84 already asks the Town conversion value; this new binary question tests only the per-use/per-piece cap.

key_context_not_required.fact: A Repeat is a separate Power use and can qualify again.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Q82/Q83 already ask the separate-use contrast; no Repeat clause is added here.

key_context_not_required.fact: Tsunami’s printed Fear, other pieces, range, thresholds, Dahan text and general mandatory-instruction rules.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: These establish a source-backed legal producer or are excluded context, not extra required answer facts.

questions.question: Bringer uses Tsunami with its threshold. Its base Damage would destroy a Town, so that Town is Pushed into an adjacent other Coastal land on the same board. Tsunami’s threshold later deals Damage in that land. Counting only nightmare-destruction Fear from that same Town, can it produce that Fear again during this single Tsunami use, or only once?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does the repeated explicit effect-text Element grant happen again?
required_facts: The Repeat resolves Elemental Boon’s explicit Element-grant effect again.

key_context_not_required.fact: Repeating does not grant printed margin Elements again.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Already actually asked in Q40 and removed from this new stem; retain its existing regression but award no second novelty credit.

key_context_not_required.fact: Powerstorm repayment, printed costs, choice timing, target restrictions, number/types of Elements and threshold numbers.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Legality/producer context or other existing asks; none is a new recital required by this question.

questions.question: A legally used Elemental Boon grants Elements through its effect text. It is then legally Repeated using Powerstorm. Does the Repeat grant the Elements specified by that effect text again?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Who may set the Spirit Phase time limit?
required_facts: Any player may set that Spirit Phase time limit; it is not reserved for the owner/organizer.

key_context_not_required.fact: Timer, condition, or other means of implementing a limit.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Implementation examples, durations and tools are not asked. The printed permission does not require a clock.

key_context_not_required.fact: The cooperative caution against being too draconian.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Adjacent etiquette guidance is not another actor-permission fact.

key_context_not_required.fact: Any claimed automatic consequence when time expires.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: No deletion of cards, loss, forced choices, skipped payments or compulsory phase-transition mechanism is printed in this passage or asked. Do not invent or grade one.

key_context_not_required.fact: The general decision fallback and ordinary phase order remain applicable in their own cases.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Q55, Q129 and Q134 already ask those distinct rules; this question requests only the specific actor permission.
